status_note: LD-arthur-blender (2026-09-29): PROPOSAL for the UE look-dev stage, written by the Blender look-dev of Arthur (profile king-arthur-h2-lookdev.json). lut.ue_lookdev = the LUT fields the Blender override format does not carry (reports/ld-lut.json ue_lut_fields: bake luminance modulation of steel_blued / gold_antique, steel wear, luminance floors if any); the UE stage owns this file and records its own iterations in lut.iterations. Not art acceptance.

gold_antique.why: the gold trims carry painted relief (lion heads, knotwork): +-30 % instead of +-12 %

steel_blued.why: engraving and the lighter gauntlets live in the bake luminance (H2.2 BC p10 / p90 = 0.47 / 1.51 of the median, gauntlets 1.5x the plate): the preset's +-15 % would flatten them; wear: the concept plate edges are gold trims, the EdgeMask of the Tripo normal also lights the engraving ridges -> 0.12 instead of 0.35 (a hint of bare iron on the ridges)

edge_mask.note: TeamMaskRGBA.A = the EdgeMask (as Merlin); textures/T_KingArthur_H2LD_EdgeMask_2K.png holds the same bytes as L8 (lookdev_ue_inputs.py indexes a channel axis, so an L source would be read as one column)
